what.en: Hot water forced through a compacted bed of fine coffee at around 9 bar. Everything happens in half a minute, which is why every variable matters so much.
what.id: Air panas ditekan lewat bubuk halus yang sudah dipadatkan, sekitar 9 bar. Semuanya kelar dalam setengah menit — makanya sedikit saja meleset langsung kerasa.

steps.en: Grind fine and dose into a dry, level basket.
steps.id: Giling halus, tuang ke basket yang kering dan rata.

steps.en: Distribute — WDT with a needle tool breaks up clumps that would otherwise channel.
steps.id: Ratakan pakai WDT. Jarumnya memecah gumpalan yang bikin air nyari jalan pintas.

steps.en: Tamp level. Pressure matters less than being flat; a tilted puck extracts unevenly.
steps.id: Tamping yang rata. Rata itu lebih penting daripada kuat — puck miring pasti ekstraksinya pincang.

steps.en: Lock in and start the shot immediately. A hot puck sitting in the group starts extracting before the pump does.
steps.id: Pasang, langsung tarik. Puck panas yang nunggu di grouphead sudah mulai terekstraksi duluan.

steps.en: Watch the first drops: 5–10 seconds before flow is normal. Under 3 means too coarse, over 15 means too fine.
steps.id: Lihat tetes pertama: 5–10 detik itu wajar. Di bawah 3 berarti kekasaran, di atas 15 kehalusan.

steps.en: Stop at your target yield by weight, not by eye.
steps.id: Stop di target hasil pakai timbangan, jangan ngira-ngira.

cause.en: Under-extracted. Grind finer or raise the dose.
cause.id: Ekstraksinya kurang. Gilingnya halusin, atau dosisnya tambah.

cause.en: Over-extracted. Grind coarser, lower the temperature, or shorten the shot.
cause.id: Kelewat ekstraksi. Gilingnya kasarin, suhunya turunin, atau shot-nya perpendek.

symptom.en: Fast then slow, tastes both sour and bitter
symptom.id: Awalnya cepat lalu melambat, rasanya asam sekaligus pahit

cause.en: Channelling. Water found a crack and skipped most of the puck. Better distribution, not a finer grind.
cause.id: Channeling — air nemu celah dan lewat begitu saja. Yang perlu diperbaiki distribusinya, bukan gilingannya.

cause.en: Far too fine, or over-dosed for the basket.
cause.id: Kehalusan, atau dosisnya kebanyakan buat basket segitu.

what.en: A single-boiler machine with a decent portafilter, plus a hand grinder. The grinder matters more than the machine — a great machine cannot fix an uneven grind.
what.id: Mesin single boiler yang portafilternya layak, plus grinder manual. Grinder lebih menentukan daripada mesinnya — mesin mahal nggak bisa nutupin gilingan yang nggak rata.

what.en: Heat exchanger or dual boiler for temperature stability, and a flat-burr electric grinder. This is where shot-to-shot consistency arrives.
what.id: Heat exchanger atau dual boiler biar suhunya stabil, plus grinder listrik burr datar. Di sini shot-mu baru mulai konsisten.

what.en: Multi-boiler with PID and pressure profiling, on-demand commercial grinder. Buys repeatability across hundreds of shots a day, not a better single shot.
what.id: Multi-boiler dengan PID dan pressure profiling, grinder komersial on-demand. Yang kamu bayar itu kemampuan ngulang ratusan shot sehari, bukan satu shot yang lebih enak.

notes.en: 58 mm is the commercial standard basket; 51 and 54 mm appear on smaller home machines and hold less coffee.
notes.id: 58 mm itu ukuran standar kafe. Mesin rumahan yang lebih kecil pakai 51 atau 54 mm dan muat lebih sedikit kopi.

notes.en: Pressurised (dual-wall) baskets create back-pressure artificially, so they forgive a bad grinder but flatten the flavour and cannot be dialled in. Non-pressurised (single-wall) baskets reward a good grinder and are what you want once you have one.
notes.id: Basket pressurized (dinding dobel) bikin tekanan balik secara buatan. Enaknya, grinder seadanya masih bisa dipakai. Nggak enaknya, rasanya jadi datar dan nggak bisa di-dial in. Begitu grinder-mu udah bagus, pindah ke non-pressurized.

what.en: A conical dripper with a large single hole — V60, Origami, Kono. You control the flow with your pour, which is what makes it expressive and unforgiving.
what.id: Dripper kerucut dengan satu lubang besar — V60, Origami, Kono. Alirannya kamu yang atur lewat cara nuang, jadi karakternya keluar banget, tapi salah dikit langsung kelihatan.

steps.en: Rinse the paper filter with hot water; it removes papery taste and preheats the brewer.
steps.id: Siram kertasnya pakai air panas dulu. Bau kertasnya hilang, alatnya sekalian anget.

steps.en: Add grounds, level the bed, and make a small well in the centre.
steps.id: Masukkan bubuknya, ratakan, bikin cekungan kecil di tengah.

steps.en: Bloom with two to three times the dose in water. Wait 30–45 seconds while it degasses.
steps.id: Bloom pakai air dua sampai tiga kali berat kopinya. Tunggu 30–45 detik sampai gasnya keluar.

steps.en: Pour in slow spirals from the centre outward, keeping the bed level.
steps.id: Nuang muter pelan dari tengah ke pinggir, jaga permukaannya tetap rata.

steps.en: Aim for 3–5 pours. Finish with a gentle swirl to flatten the bed.
steps.id: Targetnya 3–5 kali tuang. Terakhir, goyang pelan biar ampasnya rata lagi.

steps.en: Drawdown should finish shortly after the last pour.
steps.id: Airnya harus habis nggak lama setelah tuangan terakhir.

symptom.en: Drains far too fast, tastes thin

cause.en: Too coarse, or you poured too aggressively and broke the bed.
cause.id: Kekasaran, atau nuangnya kelewat deras sampai permukaannya rusak.

symptom.en: Stalls, takes far too long, bitter

cause.en: Too fine, or fines migrated and blocked the filter.
cause.id: Kehalusan, atau bubuk halusnya nyumbat kertas.

symptom.en: Grounds high on the wall when finished

cause.en: Uneven pouring. Those grounds never got extracted.
cause.id: Nuangnya nggak rata. Ampas yang di situ nggak keekstrak sama sekali.

what.en: A plastic V60 (holds heat better than glass), paper filters, and any kettle you can pour slowly from.
what.id: V60 plastik (nahan panasnya lebih bagus daripada kaca), kertas filter, dan teko apa saja yang bisa nuang pelan.

what.en: Gooseneck kettle with temperature control, and a burr grinder. The kettle changes pour control more than the dripper does.
what.id: Teko leher angsa yang ada pengatur suhunya, plus grinder burr. Tekonya lebih ngubah kontrol tuangan daripada dripper-nya sendiri.

what.en: Scale with built-in timer and flow readout. Mostly about repeating a recipe exactly.
what.id: Timbangan yang ada timer dan bacaan alirannya. Ini soal ngulang resep persis sama.

notes.en: Origami on a cone filter behaves like a V60; on a wave filter it behaves flat-bottomed.
notes.id: Origami pakai kertas kerucut kelakuannya kayak V60; pakai kertas wave jadi kayak dripper dasar rata.

notes.en: Kono's ribs stop short of the top, so the paper seals against the wall and flow slows — expect longer times than a V60.
notes.id: Rusuk Kono berhenti sebelum bibir atas, jadi kertasnya nempel ke dinding dan aliran melambat — wajar kalau lebih lama dari V60.

what.en: A flat bed with small restricted holes — Kalita Wave, Stagg [X], Orea, April. The flat bed extracts more evenly than a cone, so it is more forgiving of an imperfect pour.
what.id: Dasarnya rata, lubangnya kecil-kecil jadi alirannya tertahan — Kalita Wave, Stagg [X], Orea, April. Karena permukaannya rata, ekstraksinya lebih merata dan tuangan yang kurang rapi masih aman.

steps.en: Rinse the filter and preheat.
steps.id: Siram kertasnya, panasin alatnya.

steps.en: Add grounds and level the bed — flat means flat here, it matters more than on a cone.
steps.id: Masukkan bubuk dan ratakan — di sini rata itu lebih penting daripada di kerucut.

steps.en: Bloom with two to three times the dose, 30–45 seconds.
steps.id: Bloom dua sampai tiga kali berat kopinya, 30–45 detik.

steps.en: Pour in gentle concentric circles, avoiding the wall.
steps.id: Nuang muter pelan, jangan kena dinding.

steps.en: Keep the water level fairly constant rather than letting it drain fully between pours.
steps.id: Airnya jaga jangan sampai kering di antara tuangan.

cause.en: Too fine — the restricted holes clog more readily than a cone's.
cause.id: Kehalusan — lubang kecilnya lebih gampang mampet daripada kerucut.

cause.en: Too coarse, or the bed drained dry between pours.
cause.id: Kekasaran, atau ampasnya sempat kering di antara tuangan.

what.en: Kalita Wave 155 in stainless, and its wave filters.
what.id: Kalita Wave 155 stainless sama kertas wave-nya.

what.en: Add a gooseneck kettle and a decent grinder. Orea or April if you want faster flow and more control.
what.id: Tambah teko leher angsa dan grinder yang lumayan. Orea atau April kalau mau aliran lebih cepat dan kontrol lebih banyak.

what.en: Batch-consistent filters and a flow-measuring scale.
what.id: Kertas yang mutunya konsisten dan timbangan yang bisa baca aliran.

notes.en: Kalita's three small holes restrict flow by design, so it runs longer than a cone. That is not a fault to correct.
notes.id: Tiga lubang kecil Kalita memang sengaja nahan aliran, jadi wajar lebih lama daripada kerucut. Jadi jangan dianggap salah.

notes.en: Wave filters are dearer and less widely stocked than cone papers — worth checking before you commit.
notes.id: Kertas wave lebih mahal dan lebih susah dicari daripada kertas kerucut — cek dulu sebelum beli alatnya.

what.en: A conical brewer with a filter roughly three times the thickness of a normal paper. That filter is the whole point: it strips oils and fines, giving an unusually clean, tea-like cup.
what.id: Alat kerucut dengan kertas tiga kali lebih tebal dari biasanya. Justru kertasnya itu intinya: minyak dan bubuk halus ketahan, hasilnya bersih banget, mirip teh.

steps.en: Rinse the filter thoroughly — the thick paper carries a lot of taste. Put the triple-fold side over the spout.
steps.id: Siram kertasnya sampai bener-bener bersih — setebal itu bau kertasnya kebawa. Sisi yang tiga lipat menghadap corong.

steps.en: Add grounds coarser than you would for a V60.
steps.id: Bubuknya lebih kasar daripada buat V60.

steps.en: Bloom 30–45 seconds.
steps.id: Bloom 30–45 detik.

steps.en: Pour slowly in the centre, avoiding the wall where the filter folds.
steps.id: Nuang pelan di tengah, hindari dinding tempat kertasnya melipat.

steps.en: Expect a longer total time than any other pour-over. That is correct, not slow.
steps.id: Totalnya bakal lebih lama daripada pour-over mana pun. Itu bener, bukan kelamaan.

cause.en: Too fine. A Chemex clogs earlier than a V60 because the paper is thicker.
cause.id: Kehalusan. Chemex mampet lebih cepat daripada V60 karena kertasnya tebal.

cause.en: The filter was not rinsed enough.
cause.id: Nyiramnya kurang bersih.

cause.en: Too coarse — long contact with coarse coffee still under-extracts.
cause.id: Kekasaran — kontak lama sama bubuk kasar tetap aja kurang keekstrak.

what.en: A 6-cup Chemex and its bonded filters. Nothing else fits properly.
what.id: Chemex 6 cangkir sama kertas bawaannya. Kertas lain nggak pas.

what.en: Gooseneck kettle and a grinder that can go coarse without producing fines.
what.id: Teko leher angsa dan grinder yang bisa kasar tanpa banyak bubuk halus.

what.en: Little to add — the Chemex is already the simple end of the craft.
what.id: Hampir nggak ada tambahan — Chemex emang sisi sederhananya.

notes.en: A three-minute Chemex is fast, not normal. Judge it against 3:30–4:30.
notes.id: Chemex tiga menit itu kecepetan, bukan normal. Patokannya 3:30–4:30.

notes.en: The thick filter is why a Chemex tastes cleaner and lighter-bodied than a V60 with the same coffee.
notes.id: Kertas tebal itulah alasan Chemex kerasa lebih bersih dan ringan daripada V60 dengan kopi yang sama.

what.en: A machine that heats and doses the water for you. You control the grind and the ratio; it controls everything else.
what.id: Mesin yang manasin dan nakar airnya buat kamu. Kamu tinggal ngatur gilingan sama rasio; sisanya mesin.

steps.en: Use a ratio around 1:16 and weigh both coffee and water — the carafe markings are usually optimistic.
steps.id: Pakai rasio sekitar 1:16, dan timbang kopinya maupun airnya — garis di teko biasanya kejauhan.

steps.en: Grind medium, roughly like table salt.
steps.id: Giling medium, kira-kira sekasar garam meja.

steps.en: Check the machine reaches 92–96 °C. Many cheap brewers do not, and that is the single biggest cause of weak coffee.
steps.id: Pastiin mesinnya nyampe 92–96 °C. Banyak mesin murah nggak nyampe, dan itu penyebab utama kopi encer.

steps.en: Pull the carafe as soon as it finishes; a hotplate cooks coffee bitter within minutes.
steps.id: Angkat tekonya begitu selesai. Hotplate bikin kopi pahit dalam hitungan menit.

symptom.en: Weak and sour no matter what
symptom.id: Encer dan asam terus, diapain juga

cause.en: The machine is not getting hot enough. No grind change fixes this.
cause.id: Mesinnya kurang panas. Mau diapain gilingannya juga percuma.

cause.en: The hotplate. Decant into a thermos instead.
cause.id: Hotplate-nya. Pindahin ke termos.

symptom.id: Nggak merata, sebagian ampas masih kering

cause.en: The showerhead is not wetting the bed evenly — a known weakness on cheaper machines.
cause.id: Showerhead-nya nggak nyiram rata — kelemahan umum mesin murah.

what.en: Any brewer that actually hits temperature. Certification by a coffee body is a reasonable shortcut.
what.id: Mesin apa pun yang beneran nyampe suhunya. Cek aja yang udah disertifikasi lembaga kopi, itu patokan paling cepat.

what.en: A brewer with a proper showerhead, pre-infusion, and a thermal carafe rather than a hotplate.
what.id: Mesin dengan showerhead yang bener, ada pre-infusion, dan teko termal bukan hotplate.

what.en: Commercial batch brewer with programmable pulse profiles and a heated dispenser.
what.id: Batch brewer komersial dengan profil pulsa dan dispenser berpemanas.

notes.en: There are no bloom or pour fields for this method because the machine decides them. Score what you control.
notes.id: Metode ini nggak punya kolom bloom atau tuangan karena mesinnya yang nentuin. Yang dinilai cuma yang kamu kendalikan.

what.en: Immersion plus pressure through a paper filter. Forgiving, fast, and almost impossible to make undrinkable — which is why it travels so well.
what.id: Rendam plus tekanan, lewat kertas. Gampang, cepat, dan susah bikin yang nggak enak — makanya sering dibawa jalan.

steps.en: Rinse the filter and assemble. Upright is simpler; inverted lets you steep without drips.
steps.id: Siram kertasnya, rakit alatnya. Posisi normal lebih gampang; kebalik bikin bisa ngerendam tanpa netes.

steps.en: Add coffee, then water. Stir gently to wet everything.
steps.id: Kopi dulu, baru air. Aduk pelan biar semuanya kena.

steps.en: Steep 60–120 seconds.
steps.id: Rendam 60–120 detik.

steps.en: Press slowly and evenly — 20–30 seconds. If it presses in five, the grind is too coarse.
steps.id: Tekan pelan dan rata — 20–30 detik. Kalau lima detik udah kelar, gilingannya kekasaran.

steps.en: Stop pressing when you hear air. Pushing further pulls bitterness through.
steps.id: Berhenti pas kedengeran bunyi angin. Diterusin malah nariknya pahit.

cause.en: Too fine. Uncomfortable to push and usually bitter.
cause.id: Kehalusan. Capek dan biasanya pahit.

cause.en: Too coarse.
cause.id: Kekasaran.

cause.en: You pressed past the hiss.
cause.id: Kamu nerusin nekan lewat bunyi anginnya.

what.en: An AeroPress and paper filters. That is genuinely the whole kit.
what.id: AeroPress sama kertasnya. Beneran cuma itu.

what.en: A hand grinder and a scale. A metal filter if you want more body and less clarity.
what.id: Grinder manual dan timbangan. Filter logam kalau mau body lebih tebal, tapi jadi kurang bening.

what.en: Nothing meaningful. The AeroPress does not scale up, which is part of its charm.
what.id: Nggak ada. AeroPress emang cuma buat porsi kecil, dan itu justru enaknya.

notes.en: Lower temperatures than other methods work well here — 80–85 °C suits light roasts and reduces bitterness.
notes.id: Suhu di sini boleh lebih rendah daripada metode lain — 80–85 °C cocok buat sangrai terang dan nahan pahitnya.

notes.en: The concentrate style (1:5, then diluted) is a different drink from a full-immersion 1:15. Both are valid; decide which you are making before judging it.
notes.id: Gaya konsentrat (1:5 terus diencerin) itu minuman yang beda dari rendaman penuh 1:15. Dua-duanya sah, tapi tentuin dulu mau bikin yang mana sebelum nilai hasilnya.

what.en: Full immersion with a metal mesh. The mesh lets oils and fine particles through, which is exactly what gives it that heavy body.
what.id: Rendam penuh, saringannya logam. Minyak dan partikel halus ikut lolos, dan justru itu yang bikin body-nya tebal.

steps.en: Preheat the press. Coarse grind, like breadcrumbs.
steps.id: Panasin dulu presnya. Giling kasar, kayak remah roti.

steps.en: Add all the water at once and stir the crust after a minute.
steps.id: Tuang airnya sekaligus, terus aduk keraknya setelah semenit.

steps.en: Steep four minutes total.
steps.id: Rendam empat menit.

steps.en: Skim the foam and floating grounds off the top before plunging — this removes most of the bitterness people blame on the method.
steps.id: Sebelum ditekan, buang busa dan ampas yang ngambang di atas — ini yang ngilangin sebagian besar rasa pahit yang sering disalahin ke metodenya.

steps.en: Plunge slowly and pour immediately. Coffee left on the grounds keeps extracting.
steps.id: Tekan pelan, langsung tuang habis. Kopi yang nginep di atas ampas terus keekstrak.

cause.en: Grind too fine, or you plunged hard and forced fines through.
cause.id: Kehalusan, atau kamu nekannya kekencengan sampai bubuk halusnya lolos.

cause.en: It sat on the grounds. Decant everything as soon as you plunge.
cause.id: Kelamaan nginep di ampas. Tuang habis begitu ditekan.

cause.en: Ratio too lean, or steeped too briefly.
cause.id: Kopinya kurang banyak, atau ngerendamnya kesingkatan.

what.en: Any press and a kettle. The most forgiving brewer there is.
what.id: Pres apa aja sama teko. Alat paling gampang yang ada.

what.en: A burr grinder — fines are the enemy here, and a blade grinder makes nothing but.
what.id: Grinder burr — musuhnya di sini bubuk halus, dan grinder pisau cuma bikin itu.

what.en: A double-walled steel press for heat retention, and a cupping spoon for skimming.
what.id: Pres baja dinding dobel biar panasnya tahan, sama sendok cupping buat buang busanya.

notes.en: Skimming rather than plunging hard is the single biggest improvement most people can make.
notes.id: Buang busanya, jangan nekan kuat-kuat. Itu perbaikan paling gede yang bisa dilakuin kebanyakan orang.

what.en: Coarse coffee steeped in cold water for many hours. Low temperature extracts very little acidity, which is why it tastes sweet and soft rather than bright.
what.id: Kopi kasar direndam air dingin berjam-jam. Karena dingin, asamnya hampir nggak keekstrak — makanya rasanya manis dan lembut, bukan cerah.

steps.en: Grind coarse. Fines turn cold brew muddy and there is no filter fast enough to save it.
steps.id: Giling kasar. Bubuk halus bikin cold brew keruh, dan dan nggak ada saringan yang bisa nyelametin.

steps.en: Combine at roughly 1:8 for a concentrate, 1:15 to drink straight.
steps.id: Campur sekitar 1:8 kalau mau konsentrat, 1:15 kalau mau langsung diminum.

steps.en: Stir to wet everything, then leave it. Room temperature 12–16 hours, or in the fridge 16–24.
steps.id: Aduk sampai semuanya kena air, terus diemin. Suhu ruang 12–16 jam, atau di kulkas 16–24 jam.

steps.en: Strain through a paper filter or a cloth. Expect it to take a while.
steps.id: Saring pakai kertas atau kain. Siapin waktu, ini lama.

steps.en: Keep refrigerated and drink within a week.
steps.id: Simpen di kulkas, habisin dalam seminggu.

cause.en: Too coarse, too short, or the ratio was too lean.
cause.id: Kekasaran, kesingkatan, atau kopinya kurang banyak.

cause.en: Too fine, or you squeezed the grounds while straining.
cause.id: Kehalusan, atau ampasnya kamu peres pas nyaring.

cause.en: Left too long at room temperature. Move it to the fridge.
cause.id: Kelamaan di suhu ruang. Pindahin ke kulkas.

what.en: A jar and a paper filter. Nothing else is required.
what.id: Toples sama kertas saring. Udah, cuma itu.

what.en: A dedicated brewer with a fine mesh basket, and fridge space.
what.id: Alat khusus yang saringannya halus, sama tempat kosong di kulkas.

what.en: Nitro tap and kegs, which is a serving question rather than a brewing one.
what.id: Keran nitro dan keg — tapi itu urusan nyajiin, bukan nyeduh.

notes.en: A hot bloom — wetting the grounds with a little hot water first — brings out more aroma before the long cold steep. Worth trying; there is a field for it.
notes.id: Bloom panas — bubuknya dibasahin sedikit air panas dulu — bikin aromanya lebih keluar sebelum direndam dingin lama. Boleh dicoba — kolomnya udah disediain.

what.en: Coffee ground to a powder, boiled with the water, and served without filtering. The grounds settle in the cup rather than being removed, which makes it a decoction rather than an immersion.
what.id: Kopi digiling sehalus tepung, direbus bareng airnya, disajikan tanpa disaring. Ampasnya ngendap di cangkir, bukan dibuang — itu yang bikin ini dekoksi, bukan rendaman.

steps.en: Grind finer than espresso — it should feel like flour.
steps.id: Giling lebih halus dari espresso — harus kerasa kayak tepung.

steps.en: Combine coffee, cold water and any sugar in the ibrik before heating. Sugar goes in now, never after.
steps.id: Kopi, air dingin, sama gulanya dicampur di ibrik sebelum dipanasin. Gulanya masuk sekarang, jangan belakangan.

steps.en: Heat slowly. Do not stir once it warms.
steps.id: Panasin pelan-pelan. Jangan diaduk lagi begitu mulai anget.

steps.en: As foam rises, lift it off the heat before it boils over. Traditionally repeated two or three times.
steps.id: Pas busanya naik, angkat sebelum tumpah. Tradisinya diulang dua tiga kali.

steps.en: Pour gently, foam first, and let it settle a minute before drinking.
steps.id: Tuang pelan, busanya duluan, terus diemin sebentar sebelum diminum.

cause.en: Heated too fast, or the grind is not fine enough.
cause.id: Kecepetan manasinnya, atau gilingannya kurang halus.

cause.en: Poured too quickly, or not left to settle.
cause.id: Nuangnya kecepetan, atau nggak sempat diemin.

cause.en: It actually boiled. It should never reach a rolling boil.
cause.id: Beneran kelewat mendidih. Nggak boleh sampai menggelegak.

what.en: A copper or brass ibrik and a grinder that can reach powder — most burr grinders cannot.
what.id: Ibrik tembaga atau kuningan, sama grinder yang sanggup sehalus tepung — kebanyakan grinder burr nggak bisa.

what.en: A dedicated Turkish mill, usually a hand mill built for this fineness.
what.id: Penggiling khusus Turki, biasanya manual yang emang dibikin buat kehalusan segini.

what.en: A sand-bed heater, which heats far more evenly than a flame.
what.id: Pemanas pasir, panasnya jauh lebih rata daripada api.

notes.en: Closest relative among the other methods is kopi tubruk — both leave the grounds in the cup.
notes.id: Saudara terdekatnya di antara metode lain itu kopi tubruk — sama-sama ninggalin ampas di cangkir.

what.en: A dripper with a valve — Clever, Hario Switch. You steep like a French press, then release it through a paper filter. Immersion body with pour-over clarity.
what.id: Dripper yang ada katupnya — Clever, Hario Switch. Kamu ngerendam kayak French press, terus dilepas lewat kertas. Body-nya rendaman, beningnya pour-over.

steps.en: Rinse the filter with the valve closed.
steps.id: Siram kertasnya dengan katup ketutup.

steps.en: Add grounds and all the water at once. Stir to wet.
steps.id: Masukin bubuk sama semua airnya sekaligus. Aduk biar kena semua.

steps.en: Steep two to four minutes — this is where extraction happens, not during the drain.
steps.id: Rendam dua sampai empat menit — di sinilah ekstraksinya, bukan pas netesnya.

steps.en: Open the valve (or set it on the cup) and let it draw down.
steps.id: Buka katupnya (atau taruh di atas gelas), biarin turun.

steps.en: The drawdown should take under a minute. Longer means too fine.
steps.id: Turunnya harus di bawah semenit. Lebih dari itu berarti kehalusan.

cause.en: Too fine, or fines have blocked the paper.
cause.id: Kehalusan, atau bubuk halusnya nyumbat kertas.

cause.en: Too coarse. Steep time cannot rescue a grind that is too big.
cause.id: Kekasaran. Direndam lama pun percuma kalau gilingannya kegedean.

what.en: A Clever dripper and standard cone filters.
what.id: Clever dripper sama kertas kerucut biasa.

what.en: A Hario Switch, which lets you alternate steeping and percolating within one brew.
what.id: Hario Switch, bisa gantian ngerendam dan ngalirin dalam satu seduhan.

what.en: Not a café brewer, but excellent for tasting several coffees side by side.
what.id: Bukan alat kafe, tapi pas banget buat nyicip beberapa kopi sekaligus.

notes.en: Because extraction happens during the steep, grind affects taste less here than in a pour-over — which makes it a forgiving place to start.
notes.id: Karena ekstraksinya pas ngerendam, gilingan nggak sepenting di pour-over — makanya cocok banget buat yang baru mulai.

what.en: Vapour pressure pushes water into an upper chamber, it brews there, and a vacuum pulls it back down through a filter as it cools. Theatrical, and genuinely very clean.
what.id: Uap ndorong air ke ruang atas, kopinya diseduh di situ, terus vakum nariknya turun lewat filter pas mendingin. Seru dilihat, dan hasilnya emang bersih banget.

steps.en: Fill the lower bulb with hot water to save time, and seat the filter in the upper chamber.
steps.id: Isi bola bawahnya pakai air panas biar cepat, pasang filternya di ruang atas.

steps.en: Bring to the boil; the water rises on its own.
steps.id: Didihin; airnya bakal naik sendiri.

steps.en: Add coffee once the water is up. Stir gently to wet.
steps.id: Masukin kopinya setelah airnya naik. Aduk pelan biar kena semua.

steps.en: Brew 60–90 seconds, with a second gentle stir.
steps.id: Seduh 60–90 detik, aduk pelan sekali lagi.

steps.en: Remove the heat. The vacuum pulls it down in around 30 seconds — a good draw looks like a whirlpool.
steps.id: Angkat dari api. Vakumnya narik turun sekitar 30 detik — tarikan yang bagus keliatan kayak pusaran.

cause.en: Too fine, or the filter is clogged.
cause.id: Kehalusan, atau filternya mampet.

symptom.en: Water rises before you are ready

cause.en: Normal — just heat more gently.
cause.id: Wajar — panasinnya pelanin aja.

cause.en: Too coarse, or too short in the upper chamber.
cause.id: Kekasaran, atau kesingkatan di ruang atas.

what.en: A 3-cup siphon and a butane burner. Cloth filters need proper care.
what.id: Siphon 3 cangkir sama kompor butana. Filter kainnya butuh dirawat serius.

what.en: A halogen beam heater, which is far easier to control than a flame.
what.id: Pemanas halogen, jauh lebih gampang diatur daripada api.

what.en: A multi-station siphon bar. Almost entirely about presentation.
what.id: Bar siphon banyak stasiun. Hampir semuanya soal tampilan.

notes.en: Cloth filters give the cleanest cup but must be kept wet in the fridge and replaced often. Paper and metal are easier.
notes.id: Filter kain hasilnya paling bening tapi harus selalu basah di kulkas dan sering diganti. Kertas sama logam lebih gampang.

what.en: Indonesian home coffee: fine grounds and sugar in the glass, boiling water poured over, and you wait for it to settle. No filter, no equipment.
what.id: Kopi rumahan: bubuk sama gula langsung di gelas, disiram air panas, terus tunggu ngendap. Nggak pakai saringan, nggak pakai alat.

steps.en: Put fine grounds and sugar straight into the glass.
steps.id: Bubuk sama gulanya langsung masuk gelas.

steps.en: Pour water just off the boil.
steps.id: Siram air yang baru turun dari mendidih.

steps.en: Stir once, then leave it alone.
steps.id: Aduk sekali, terus diemin.

steps.en: Wait four to five minutes for the grounds to sink.
steps.id: Tunggu empat lima menit sampai ampasnya turun.

steps.en: Drink from the top and stop before the sludge.
steps.id: Minum dari atas, berhenti sebelum kena ampasnya.

cause.en: Not settled long enough, or stirred again after settling.
cause.id: Belum cukup ngendap, atau keaduk lagi setelah ngendap.

cause.en: Water at a full boil, or left far too long before drinking.
cause.id: Airnya masih menggelegak, atau kelamaan didiemin sebelum diminum.

what.en: A glass and a kettle. That is the entire method, and it is why it is everywhere.
what.id: Gelas sama teko. Cuma itu metodenya, makanya ada di mana-mana.

what.en: A grinder, so you can use fresh single-origin instead of pre-ground blends.
what.id: Grinder, biar bisa pakai biji segar bukan bubuk kemasan.

what.en: Not a café method, though some specialty shops serve it to make a point.
what.id: Bukan metode kafe, walau ada juga kedai specialty yang nyajiin.

notes.en: Sugar traditionally goes in before the water, which helps it dissolve and slightly changes the extraction.
notes.id: Gulanya biasanya masuk sebelum air. Lebih gampang larut, dan sedikit ngubah ekstraksinya.

notes.en: Usually made with pre-ground coffee — Kapal Api, Nescafe, or a local roaster's bubuk — which is why the roaster and roast date fields are not asked for.
notes.id: Biasanya pakai bubuk jadi — Kapal Api, Nescafe, atau bubuk roaster lokal — makanya kolom roaster dan tanggal sangrai nggak ditanyain.

what.en: Coffee brewed and strained through a cloth sock, common across Indonesia and Malaysia. The cloth holds back grounds while letting oils through, so it sits between filter and immersion.
what.id: Kopi diseduh terus disaring lewat kain. Kainnya nahan ampas tapi ngelolosin minyak, jadi posisinya di tengah-tengah antara filter dan rendaman.

steps.en: Rinse the sock in hot water — a dry cloth tastes of cloth.
steps.id: Siram kainnya pakai air panas — kain kering bakal kerasa kainnya.

steps.en: Add fine grounds to the sock and set it in the pot.
steps.id: Masukin bubuk halus ke kain, taruh di panci.

steps.en: Pour hot water through slowly.
steps.id: Siram air panas pelan-pelan.

steps.en: Pour the result back through a second time for a stronger cup — this is the traditional 'tarik' idea.
steps.id: Saring ulang hasilnya sekali lagi kalau mau lebih pekat — ini ide 'tarik' yang klasik.

steps.en: Rinse the sock immediately after and store it wet, in the fridge if you brew daily.
steps.id: Habis dipakai langsung dicuci, simpen dalam keadaan basah. Kalau tiap hari nyeduh, taruh di kulkas.

cause.en: The sock. Old coffee oils go rancid in cloth faster than anywhere else.
cause.id: Kainnya. Minyak kopi lama jadi tengik di kain lebih cepat daripada di mana pun.

cause.en: Water passed too quickly. Pour slower, or pass it twice.
cause.id: Airnya lewat kecepetan. Nuangnya pelanin, atau saring dua kali.

what.en: A cloth sock and a pot. Buy two so one is always clean.
what.id: Kain saring sama panci. Beli dua biar selalu ada yang bersih.

what.en: A dedicated pouring kettle and several socks in rotation.
what.id: Teko tuang khusus dan beberapa kain buat gantian.

what.en: Standard kit in a warung, where the sock is used continuously and rinsed constantly.
what.id: Perlengkapan standar warung — kainnya dipakai terus, dicuci terus.

notes.en: Cloth care is the whole method. A neglected sock ruins good coffee more reliably than any grind error.
notes.id: Ngerawat kainnya itu inti metodenya. Kain yang diabaikan lebih pasti ngerusak kopi bagus daripada salah giling.

what.en: Yogyakarta street coffee: a glowing lump of charcoal dropped straight into the glass. The charcoal neutralises some acidity and adds a distinct smoky note.
what.id: Kopi kaki lima Jogja: bara arang nyala dicemplungin langsung ke gelas. Arangnya nurunin sebagian asamnya dan ninggalin aroma asap yang khas.

steps.en: Brew a strong tubruk-style coffee with sugar.
steps.id: Bikin kopi tubruk yang pekat pakai gula.

steps.en: Heat a lump of hardwood charcoal until it glows right through.
steps.id: Bakar arang kayu keras sampai nyala merata.

steps.en: Knock the ash off, then drop it into the glass. It will hiss and foam hard.
steps.id: Ketok abunya, terus cemplungin ke gelas. Bakal mendesis dan berbuih kenceng.

steps.en: Leave the charcoal in for about a minute, then lift it out.
steps.id: Biarin arangnya di dalam sekitar semenit, terus angkat.

steps.en: Let it settle before drinking.
steps.id: Diemin sampai ngendap sebelum diminum.

cause.en: The charcoal was not fully glowing, or the ash was not knocked off.
cause.id: Arangnya belum nyala penuh, atau abunya nggak diketok.

cause.en: The charcoal cooled too fast, or came out too soon.
cause.id: Arangnya kecepetan dingin, atau kecepetan diangkat.

what.en: Hardwood charcoal only — never briquettes, which contain binders you should not drink.
what.id: Arang kayu keras aja — jangan briket, ada perekatnya dan itu bukan buat diminum.

what.en: Tongs and a small brazier.
what.id: Japitan sama anglo kecil.

what.en: A street cart with a permanent charcoal fire, which is where it belongs.
what.id: Gerobak kaki lima yang baranya nyala terus, dan emang di situ tempatnya.

notes.en: Use lump hardwood charcoal, not barbecue briquettes. Briquettes are bound with additives that are not food-safe.
notes.id: Pakai arang kayu keras, bukan briket barbeku. Briket direkat pakai bahan tambahan yang nggak aman dikonsumsi.

notes.en: Usually made with pre-ground coffee — Kapal Api, Nescafe, or a local roaster's bubuk — which is why the roaster and roast date fields are not asked for.
notes.id: Biasanya pakai bubuk jadi, makanya kolom roaster dan tanggal sangrai nggak ditanyain.

what.en: Minangkabau egg coffee. A raw yolk is whipped with sugar until pale and thick, then strong coffee is poured over it, leaving a foam layer on top.
what.id: Kopi telur khas Minang. Kuning telur mentah dikocok sama gula sampai pucat dan kental, terus disiram kopi pekat — busanya ngambang di atas.

steps.en: Whip a raw egg yolk with sugar until pale, thick and roughly doubled — two to three minutes of hard work.
steps.id: Kocok kuning telur mentah sama gula sampai pucat, kental, dan kira-kira jadi dua kali lipat. Dua tiga menit ngocok beneran.

steps.en: Brew strong coffee separately.
steps.id: Seduh kopi pekat terpisah.

steps.en: Pour the hot coffee slowly over the whipped yolk without stirring it in.
steps.id: Siram kopinya pelan-pelan di atas kocokan telur, jangan diaduk.

steps.en: The foam should sit on top. Some add cinnamon or nutmeg.
steps.id: Busanya harus ngambang di atas. Ada yang nambahin kayu manis atau pala.

steps.en: Drink through the foam rather than mixing it.
steps.id: Minum nembus busanya, jangan diaduk dulu.

cause.en: Coffee too hot or poured too fast. Slow down.
cause.id: Kopinya kepanasan atau nuangnya kecepetan. Pelanin.

cause.en: The yolk was not whipped long enough.
cause.id: Kuning telurnya kurang lama dikocok.

cause.en: Not enough sugar, or the egg was not fresh.
cause.id: Gulanya kurang, atau telurnya nggak segar.

what.en: A whisk and a strong arm. A milk frother works too.
what.id: Pengocok sama tenaga. Frother susu juga bisa.

what.en: An electric hand whisk, which makes the texture far more consistent.
what.id: Mixer tangan listrik, teksturnya jadi jauh lebih konsisten.

what.en: Served in Padang restaurants, whipped to order.
what.id: Disajiin di rumah makan Padang, dikocok pas dipesan.

notes.en: This uses raw egg. Use very fresh eggs, and skip it if you are pregnant or immunocompromised.
notes.id: Ini pakai telur mentah. Pilih telur yang bener-bener segar, dan lewatin aja kalau lagi hamil atau daya tahan tubuhmu lagi turun.

notes.en: Usually made with pre-ground coffee — Kapal Api, Nescafe, or a local roaster's bubuk — which is why the roaster and roast date fields are not asked for.
notes.id: Biasanya pakai bubuk jadi, makanya kolom roaster dan tanggal sangrai nggak ditanyain.

what.en: From Aceh: the glass is served upside down on a saucer, and you drink the coffee as it seeps out, through a straw. The inverted glass keeps it hot for a remarkably long time.
what.id: Dari Aceh: gelasnya disajiin kebalik di atas piring, kopinya diminum pas ngerembes keluar, pakai sedotan. Gelas kebalik bikin panasnya awet lama banget.

steps.en: Brew strong coffee and pour it into a small glass.
steps.id: Seduh kopi pekat, tuang ke gelas kecil.

steps.en: Cover the glass with a saucer and invert the whole thing in one movement.
steps.id: Tutup gelasnya pakai piring, balik semuanya sekali gerak.

steps.en: Lift the glass slightly so a little coffee escapes onto the saucer.
steps.id: Angkat gelasnya dikit biar kopinya keluar ke piring.

steps.en: Drink from the saucer with a straw, or sip directly.
steps.id: Minum dari piring pakai sedotan, atau seruput langsung.

steps.en: The seal keeps it hot far longer than an open cup.
steps.id: Karena rapat, panasnya awet jauh lebih lama daripada cangkir biasa.

cause.en: The flip was hesitant. It has to be one confident motion.
cause.id: Baliknya ragu-ragu. Harus sekali gerak yang mantap.

cause.en: The seal is too good — tilt the glass very slightly.
cause.id: Kerapatannya kelewat bagus — miringin gelasnya dikit aja.

what.en: A small thick glass and a flat saucer. The glass must have a smooth rim to seal.
what.id: Gelas kecil yang tebal sama piring datar. Bibir gelasnya harus rata biar bisa rapat.

what.en: Nothing to add; the method is the equipment.
what.id: Nggak ada tambahan; metodenya ya alatnya.

what.en: Served across West Aceh, where the flip is done with practised speed.
what.id: Ada di seluruh Aceh Barat, dan baliknya dilakuin cepat banget karena udah biasa.

notes.en: Grounds stay in the glass, which is part of why it works — they are held against the saucer.
notes.id: Ampasnya tetap di gelas, dan justru itu yang bikin cara ini bisa jalan — ampasnya ketahan di piring.

notes.en: Usually made with pre-ground coffee — Kapal Api, Nescafe, or a local roaster's bubuk — which is why the roaster and roast date fields are not asked for.
notes.id: Biasanya pakai bubuk jadi, makanya kolom roaster dan tanggal sangrai nggak ditanyain.
